name: Lower Saxony
summary: The German black, red and gold tricolour with the state arms in the centre: a white horse rearing on a red shield, the Saxon Steed.
origin: Lower Saxony was formed in 1946 from Hanover, Brunswick, Oldenburg and Schaumburg-Lippe. The Saxon Steed, a white horse on red, was the emblem of the Kingdom of Hanover and the House of Guelph. The flag was adopted in 1952.

symbols.name: Saxon Steed
symbols.description: A white horse rearing on red.
symbols.meaning: The ancient Saxons and the House of Guelph (Hanover).

facts: The Saxon Steed also appears on the arms of North Rhine-Westphalia.
clues: The German tricolour with a white horse on a red shield.
Its horse is the Saxon Steed.
A northern German state formed in 1946.
